footer.tagline: Made for easier group trip planning.

landing.title: Coordinate group travel dates in one shared link.
landing.subtitle: No signup, no passwords. Create a trip, share the URL, and let everyone mark available dates.
landing.tripNameLabel: What should we call this trip?
landing.participantsHint: Add at least one person before creating your shared trip page.
landing.limitToMonthHint: When enabled, everyone opening the link will see only this month.

trip.noParticipantsBody: Ask the organizer to recreate the trip and add participant names first.
trip.closedHint: Dates are set — now plan the details with your group.

calendar.title: When can you travel?

calendar.lockedSubtitle: This trip has been closed. Dates are locked.

userPicker.title: Who are you?

groupAvailability.title: Group availability

schedule.title: Trip schedule
schedule.subtitle: Plan activities for each day. Hover a time slot to add something.

flights.title: Search flights
